component.name: OpenYog
component.summary: Query and manage MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite databases

description.p: OpenYog is a desktop database client built on the SQLyog Community Edition source, with a Qt 6 interface in place of the original Windows-only one. It is an independent community fork, not affiliated with Webyog or Idera.

ul.li: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite connections
Query editor with syntax highlighting and context-aware autocomplete
Editable table data: staged edits applied in one transaction
Create and alter tables, indexes, foreign keys, views and routines
SQL dump backups, database copy, CSV import and export
Saved passwords kept in the system keychain
